name: xfce
description: XFCE desktop image: lightweight desktop session, panel + root-window context menu.

oracle.label: xfce-desktop
oracle.expect: XFCE desktop with the panel drawn
oracle.rules_out: a bare root window with no panel (xfdesktop/xfce4-panel failing to start)

notes: XFCE is the surface behind #432 (smithay GetPointer race: no retroactive pointer-enter). A mouse gate that fails here with a healthy-looking desktop is that class of bug, not necessarily an image defect — check the agent log for the pointer-enter path before reporting.
